rationale.hitl-workflow: ACIP introduces human gates requiring explicit comprehension confirmation of AI code
rationale.oversight-explanation: EEL provides visual documentation of AI decision-making and alternative approaches
rationale.rules-based-checks: AGDV and CIW perform automated deterministic checks on documentation and metrics
rationale.framework: proposes VIBE4M, a multi-layered pipeline architecture for AI code integration
rationale.design-only: specifies components, metrics, and formulas for VIBE4M without evaluating them
rationale.agentic: studies vibe coding where AI generates complete applications and artifacts
rationale.metrics: defines ASMM metrics for quality and comprehensibility of AI code
rationale.risk-quality: devotes focal analysis to technical debt and code quality decay
rationale.risk-security: devotes focal analysis to security vulnerabilities in vibe coding
rationale.counterpoint: argues against vibe coding hype replacing developers and structured engineering
